body:
Add test cases to verify the integration features:
1. Add a unit test in test/unit.test.mjs verifying that bootstrap() successfully falls back to using the 'jetski' CLI when 'agy' is not available on the path.
2. Add an integration test in test/integration-plugin.test.mjs verifying that the MCP server successfully handles '$/cancel' notifications by terminating active child processes.
title: test(integration): add jetski fallback unit test and MCP process cancellation test
